description: This file defines the WatchConnectivityReceiver class responsible for handling WatchConnectivity sessions, message sending, and receiving notifications between an iOS app extension and a watchOS app. It includes data structures for reply drafts and results, and implements the WCSessionDelegate methods to process incoming messages and payloads.

classes.name: WatchConnectivityReceiver
classes.description: A class that manages the WCSession for communication between the watch and the phone, handling message transmission and reception.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the WCSession and sets the delegate.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until the session is activated, with retries.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to the watch with specified payload, attempting immediate delivery or queuing for later.
